name: Valentin Amezquita
office: City of Huntington Park, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Valentin Amezquita is a retired environmental scientist who worked 35 years for the Port of Los Angeles and LADWP. His county statement lists public safety, parking solutions and city services among his goals. As a former Huntington Park city councilmember, he criticized city spending, including $4 million for soil removal and $8 million transferred to a New York company.

sentences.text: Valentin Amezquita is a retired environmental scientist who worked 35 years for the Port of Los Angeles and LADWP.
His county statement lists public safety, parking solutions and city services among his goals.
As a former Huntington Park city councilmember, he criticized city spending, including $4 million for soil removal and $8 million transferred to a New York company.

items.text: As a councilmember in 2013, he voted against a towing fee increase. He later recorded meetings as an FBI informant for a federal bribery case. In 2025, a court rejected his lawsuit to compel a special election and awarded litigation costs to the city. In 2016, the FPPC fined him $200 for failing to pay a campaign committee fee.
